decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core to a large German work-shoe maker, so it will stay in the portfolio despite only being mentioned on the website.
Comfort insoles are a low-cost complement to the work-shoe range and support cross-selling, though accessory variants are sometimes consolidated.
Supportive insoles meet ergonomic and occupational health demand, but they overlap with the other insoles and could be merged into one line.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own page, which signals strategic importance and investment the firm will want to recoup.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a certified niche with long public procurement cycles, so they are unlikely to be withdrawn after one year.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page shows it is a flagship innovation the firm is actively promoting.
